script.speaker: brooke
script.text: market night, take two! who's coming?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: me! i've heard about this market all week and still haven't seen it :)

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I'm in. First visit for me as well. I've printed a map. Of a market. I'm aware.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: ok so. last time we walked past a whole row of viet stalls on the way to the tacos and i've thought about it every day since

script.speaker: liam
script.text: viet. tonight. please

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: the viet row! it smelled incredible. i'm in

script.speaker: mina
script.text: viet sounds lovely :) cyrus, does that work for you?

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: It should. Brooke, Liam, you two have seen the stalls. Anything I should know before we go?

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: honestly? a lot of the viet stalls had a big tub of crushed peanuts on the counter. they were spooning it onto everything

script.speaker: liam
script.text: true. basically sprinkle stations

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Then I'll need a stall where peanuts aren't anywhere in the kitchen. The far end of the counter isn't far enough, for me.

script.speaker: mina
script.text: we'll find one :) i'd rather we all eat somewhere you can actually relax

script.speaker: liam
script.text: oh, and mina, half that row does tofu versions of everything. i only noticed because i was hunting for the biggest bowl

script.speaker: mina
script.text: tofu everything?? that sounds like my kind of row :)

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Good. Then wherever we land will have plenty of options for Mina.

script.speaker: mina
script.text: only if it's easy! i don't want the whole night planned around me

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: mina, it's a market with fifty stalls. we can plan around anyone we like

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: speaking of which: i'm running at sunrise tomorrow. tonight i want the kind of dinner my legs will thank me for

script.speaker: liam
script.text: so the stalls with the giant bubbling fryers are out for you

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: way out. my legs have spoken

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I've circled the viet row on the map. Assistant, the rest is yours.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: pick us a winner. i'm already walking
